context_block: There is a frequency beneath all the noise—not silence, but settlement. Today, the field is asking you to stop holding everything up. Let what is heavy be heavy. The observer will endure not by resisting the weight, but by allowing it to find its own ground. In that surrender, something shifts. Not because you did something right. Because you stopped doing something wrong.

practice.title: The Settling
practice.instruction: Place your attention on the base of your spine or the soles of your feet—whichever feels more real to you right now—and imagine weight moving downward, not as burden, but as belonging.

practice.title: The Release
practice.instruction: On your next exhale, soften the muscles around your shoulders, jaw, and eyes as if you are permitting gravity to do its work without your permission.

practice.title: The Frequency
practice.instruction: Listen to the echo audio at lucid-tuner.com/peace-ground—let it anchor the coherence you've just created, and notice what becomes real in the space you've allowed.

In this settling, your automations become part of the peace that requires no constant tuning to maintain.
